title: Drunk Entitled Brat Behaves In The Worst Possible Way During Traffic Stop
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 12th, 2023. Officers conducted a traffic stop on a highly intoxicated woman who was driving erratically. When officers approached the woman, they could immediately tell she was intoxicated, she kept saying things that made no sense at all. During the search of her car, they found a pill bottle full of Xanax along with other pills. During the field exercises, she refused to listen and obey commands which resulted in her failing miserably, she had to be placed under arrest, she started resisting and fighting with officers and saying she did nothing wrong. During the transport, she took of her pants and peed on the car seat.   This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
